items.quote: if you're still using the outdated sales techniques saying, uh what is your budget, mister?
items.statement: Do not ask clients outright about their budget as it is outdated and ineffective.

items.quote: What do you have in mind in terms of the price point?
items.statement: Use conversational and open-ended questions to ascertain clients' price points.

overview: A YouTube short discussing questions to ask clients about their budget in sales processes.
